pin.title: ITALIAN RESORT PERTICA — Tamazakai Opens 2026-10-30
pin.description: An upcoming Italian restaurant in Machida with fresh pasta, pizza, meat dishes and a self-service drink bar. Opening October 30; planned hours 10:30–23:00, last orders 22:00. Launch images are operator illustrations.
pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: Operator release dated October 19 explicitly confirms Tamazakai grand opening October 30, 2026; exact branch listing corroborates. Older November 2 reporting is superseded. Brand founding and former Gusto opening are not this branch date.
pin.longFormSummary:
An upcoming Italian restaurant in Machida with fresh pasta, pizza, meat dishes and a self-service drink bar. Opening October 30; planned hours 10:30–23:00, last orders 22:00. Launch images are operator illustrations.

Operator release dated October 19 explicitly confirms Tamazakai grand opening October 30, 2026; exact branch listing corroborates. Older November 2 reporting is superseded. Brand founding and former Gusto opening are not this branch date.
